data.name: Fairoze
data.gender_notes: Fairoze is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fairoze is derived from the word 'Fair', which means 'victorious' or 'triumphant'. This name is often given to girls to symbolize their strength and victory over life's challenges. In Islamic history, many women with this name are known for their bravery and determination. The name Fairoze carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fairoze usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Fairoze belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fairoze total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
